avoid.flag: Claims Google Home works as a Zigbee hub; 1,100 W limit
avoid.verdict: The listing tells you to pair these to Google Home as a Zigbee hub, which no Google device can do, and they're rated well below a standard plug.
reasons: It names Google Home as a compatible Zigbee hub. Google's speakers and displays don't have Zigbee radios.
It's rated for 1,100 W per plug, below the 15 A (about 1,800 W) that most plugs here handle.
Only FCC and RoHS are listed, neither of which is an electrical safety certification like ETL or UL.
The listing warns against plugging two into a compact dual-port strip.
